✨ swarms | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Orchestrating complex multi-agent AI systems in production environments.
✨ Key Features: • Enterprise-grade multi-agent orchestration • Production-ready architectures (sequential, concurrent, hierarchical) • Scalable and adaptive systems • Backward compatibility with leading agent frameworks • Interoperability with protocols like MCP, x402, skills
📖 Summary: Swarms is an enterprise-grade, production-ready framework for orchestrating multi-agent systems. It provides scalable and adaptive architectures for sequential, concurrent, and hierarchical agent interactions, with backward compatibility and interoperability with various AI protocols.
